title: 0.999… with nines forever is exactly equal to 1, not just close
body: One quick way to see it: 1/3 = 0.333…, and three times that is 0.999…, while three times 1/3 is exactly 1. More rigorously, two different real numbers always have some gap between them, but no positive gap fits between 0.999… and 1, because the endless 9s get closer than any distance you can name. They are simply two ways of writing the same number, just as 8.32 can also be written 8.31999….
